messages:
Ana (Marketing): quick ask — can we create a single-page "Risk & ROI Decision Snapshot" for enterprise buyers that compares Hosted / Dedicated / Private across security, SLA, latency, and cost? needs to be field-ready for next week's webinar and a short launch post. :spiral_calendar:
Josh (Product): love that name. objective: make buying decision <60s. include recommended guardrails (when to pick which mode), 2 benchmark callouts, and 1-line elevator for each persona.
Sara (Field): must call out KMS/HSM, VPC, and audit log retention differences. field asks for a one-liner to drop into discovery call notes.
Mike (Sales): also need an inbound-routing hint: which leads should auto-route to AE vs. SE. low-touch vs. high-touch criteria.
Ana (Marketing): draft outline I had in mind:
```
- Top: 2-sentence problem framing (risk vs. speed vs. cost)
- Middle: 3-column comparison (Hosted | Dedicated | Private) with 4 rows: Security controls, SLA/uptime, Latency/throughput, Unit economics
- Bottom left: Quick persona callouts (Platform lead, CISO, Product manager)
- Bottom right: Routing + next steps (webinar CTA / field play)
```
Josh (Product): can we include 2 benchmark nuggets for the webinar: (1) 95th-pctl latency on Hosted for 1k qps with 256-token avg = ~85ms; (2) Dedicated with reserved GPUs gives ~30% lower cost at scale (1M tokens/day). numbers should be labeled as "example workload"
Sara (Field): sample one-liners for discovery:
- Platform lead: "We recommend Dedicated for predictable 99.95% throughput and private network controls."
- CISO: "Private deployment with customer KMS and audit retention meets our baseline for regulated workloads."
- PM: "Hosted is fastest to ship with streaming + tool-calling enabled."
Mike (Sales): inbound routing pseudo-rules (for ops to implement):
```yaml
if security_requirements in ["SOC2+, FedRAMP*, PCI"] or data_residency == true:
  route: high-touch AE + SE
elif expected_peak_tokens_per_day >= 1_000_000 and latency_sla <= 50ms:
  route: dedicated-sales
else:
  route: self-serve-nurture
```
Ana (Marketing): good — marketing copy notes: keep text <150 words, use two-tone header (Risk / ROI). add an accessibility-friendly PDF and 1-slide summary for field.
Josh (Product): small tweak — for SLAs call out "SLA-backed latency tiers" for Dedicated; for Hosted say "best-effort latency with region fallback". add a tiny note about automatic model fallbacks in the runtime.
Sara (Field): will add an example customer scenario: "FinServ: needs VPC + HSM, 99.9% uptime, route to Private". also add one-sentence migration path: Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private as org scales.
Mike (Sales): CTA language for launch post: "Which deployment matches your risk profile? Book a 15-min discovery with our infra specialists." include link short: https://redwood.ai/book-demo (placeholder). add :rocket:
deploy-bot: file upload: 1745009876-risk-roi-snapshot-v1.pdf added to thread.
Ana (Marketing): action items + owners:
- Ana: write first-draft one-pager (by EOD today)
- Josh: fact-check benchmark numbers + product blurbs (tomorrow morning)
- Sara: add 2 field scenarios + discovery one-liners (tomorrow noon)
- Mike: routing rules to ops + suggested CTA (tomorrow afternoon)
- Design: create 1-slide summary + accessible PDF (need 24h after draft)
Josh (Product): ack. I'll validate numbers and add a 1-line "fallbacks" note.
Sara (Field): will post final discovery snippets in this thread when ready.
Mike (Sales): will prep a short playbook snippet for AE messaging after we lock the copy.
Ana (Marketing): thanks team. goal: finalize for webinar pre-read by Friday AM. if anything blocks, ping me or drop a version into the thread. :white_check_mark:
